Retirement Party DJ, San Francisco, Bay Area

If your looking for entertainment for a retiree, Work Partner, Collegue or Husband/Wife, Friend, Boss, Hiring a DJ is the Way to go.

We can Act as the master of ceremonys ( MC ) or maybe you have some speakers who will speak, Toasts and Roast to the special person that is going to retire.

Whether you want soft cocktail / dinner type music and or Dancing our California DJs will be happy to make this day as memorable as all the days you were all working together and go out with a big shubang.

Retirement DJ
We make the process a lot of fun we are happy to work along with you and also if you have performers, dancers, singers, at our last retirement party they had a cher impersonator, weve also seen an elvis impersonator and hawaiian polynesian dancers, indian dances and swing dancers ( hey big spender ) and also fancy dress theme parties either way we can work with them too and play there ( cds, ipod ) music.

Heres just a couple of songs weve played for other retiring Parties:
Take This Job and Shove it –
Hit The Road Jack – Ray Charles
Im leaving on a Jet Plane – John Denver
Hard Working Man – Brooks & Dunn
We Are Family – Sister Sledge 
Kenny Rogers – Through The Years
Nat King Cole – Unforgettable 
Plus many more that you like we will play the songs you ask for.

Contact Us For Your Retirement Party 

Retirement Party DJ – Frequently Asked Questions

Who is a Retirement Party DJ suitable for?

Our DJs provide entertainment for retirees, work partners, colleagues, spouses, friends, or bosses celebrating their retirement.

Can the DJ act as a Master of Ceremonies (MC)?

Yes, our DJs can act as the MC or coordinate with your speakers for toasts, roasts, and special announcements during the party.

What kind of music do you play at retirement parties?

We play a mix of soft cocktail and dinner music as well as lively dance tunes to make the celebration memorable and fun.

Do you work with other performers or themed parties?

Yes, we happily collaborate with performers such as impersonators, dancers, singers, and support themed or fancy dress parties.

Can you play music from CDs or personal devices?

We can play music from CDs, iPods, or any other device you prefer to use for your event.

What are some popular songs you play at retirement parties?

Examples include “Take This Job and Shove It,” “Hit The Road Jack,” “I’m Leaving on a Jet Plane,” “Hard Working Man,” “We Are Family,” “Through The Years,” “Unforgettable,” and many more.

How can I contact you to book a Retirement Party DJ?

Please contact us via our website or phone to book and discuss your retirement party entertainment needs.
